item.title: Rumors Link Meta and Fourier to Humanoid Robot Project
item.description:
Rumors suggest Meta is collaborating with Chinese robotics firm Fourier to build a humanoid robot prototype named Max within three months, powered by an NVIDIA Thor chip. While reports indicate work on a second-generation model has begun, Fourier's CEO declined to comment, leaving the partnership unconfirmed and the event currently speculative.

原文标题：传 Meta 与傅利叶合作开发人形机器人 Max

Why it matters：涉及 AI 巨头与头部机器人企业的潜在跨界合作，虽未证实但具备较高行业关注度。

item.title: Starship Robot Causes Crash, Blames Ad Board Interference
item.description:
A Starship delivery robot caused a crash in Tallinn, injuring nine passengers after running a red light. The company attributed the incident to poor lighting and visual interference from an illuminated ad board behind the traffic signal, while denying hit-and-run allegations. This highlights perception limitations of L4 autonomous systems in complex lighting and adversarial visual scenarios.

原文标题：Starship 无人车闯红灯致伤，归咎广告牌干扰

Why it matters：揭示了当前自主配送机器人在极端视觉条件下的感知失效风险，对具身智能落地具有警示意义。

item.title: CATL Founder: AI Accelerates Material Screening, Identifies 7 Potential Compounds
item.description:
At the 2026 World Laureates Forum, CATL founder Robin Zeng revealed that the company uses AI to process over 600TB of foundational data and trillions of test records. This approach enables rapid screening of thousands of compounds to identify seven potential materials, accelerating energy research innovation, though Zeng noted current AI capabilities remain insufficient without broader scientific collaboration.

原文标题：宁德时代曾毓群：AI 加速材料筛选，锁定 7 种潜力化合物

Why it matters：展示了 AI 在垂直领域（电池材料）大规模数据处理中的实际落地效果，但缺乏具体技术细节与方法论。

item.title: Samsung Forecasts \u003e100% Utilization for Advanced Nodes by 2027 Driven by HPC Demand
item.description:
Driven by surging AI and HPC demand, Samsung forecasts that utilization rates for its 8nm and below advanced nodes will exceed 100% by 2027, with 2nm project counts doubling year-over-year. To address the supply-demand gap, the company is considering building new fabs in the US and South Korea to expand capacity for 2nm, 4nm, and 8nm processes.

原文标题：三星预测 2027 年先进制程利用率破百，HPC 驱动扩产

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 算力需求对半导体制造产能的实质性挤压及巨头扩产动向，具有行业风向标意义。

item.title: Envision Deploys World's First Commercial 800V SST Power System for AI Data Centers
item.description:
Envision Group announced the commercial operation of its integrated 800V high-voltage DC power system at the Ulanqab Xinghe base, marking the world's first deployment of such a system in a large-scale AI data center. The solution integrates solid-state transformers and DC energy storage to close the loop from green electricity generation to compute load, with a planned capacity of 3GW and over 80% direct green power connection.

原文标题：远景 800V SST 高压直流系统全球首套 AI 数据中心商业化运行

Why it matters：AI 数据中心电力架构的重要工程节点，验证了高压直流与绿电直连在大规模算力场景下的商业可行性。

item.description:
The first CMG World Robot Mount Tai Climbing Competition was held in Tai'an, Shandong, featuring nearly 90 teams. Beijing Lingyi Technology won the legged robot racing category with a time of 43 minutes and 41 seconds, demonstrating robotic mobility on complex terrain.

item.title: UBTECH Launches Thinker-Sim Embodied AI Simulation Platform
item.description:
UBTECH has released Thinker-Sim, an embodied AI simulation platform designed to create a one-stop technical system from real-world digitization to robot capability evaluation. The platform utilizes proprietary high-fidelity reconstruction algorithms and automated asset generation technologies to rapidly convert real environments, such as factories, into interactive simulation scenes, offering standardized task templates to simplify training and validation workflows.

item.title: China Telecom et al. Verify First Thousand-Kilometer Hollow-Core Fiber Real-Time Transmission
item.description:
China Telecom, YOFC, and ZTE completed the world's first real-time bidirectional transmission verification over a 1007.48 km hollow-core fiber link, achieving a total capacity of 128 Tb/s. The trial overcame gas line absorption challenges and optimized amplifier strategies, providing key technical evidence for building high-bandwidth, low-latency backbone networks.

原文标题：中国电信等完成全球首个千公里空芯光纤实时传输验证

Why it matters：突破空芯光纤长距离传输瓶颈，对AI算力集群互联基础设施具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Opinion: AI Agents Handle Implementation, Engineers Own Decisions
item.description:
The article argues that in software engineering, AI agents should primarily handle execution tasks like implementation, analysis, and testing, while human engineers retain final decision-making authority over system architecture, problem definition, and acceptance criteria. The author rejects the notion of reducing developers to 'typists,' emphasizing that automation does not eliminate engineering responsibility; the core challenge lies in maintaining decision visibility and feedback utility while leveraging these tools.

原文标题：AI 辅助编程观点：智能体接管实现，工程师负责决策

Why it matters：提供了关于人机协作边界的清晰观点，适合关注 AI 编程工作流变革的读者参考，但缺乏具体技术数据或新工具发布。

item.title: Meituan Releases LongCat-2.5: A 1.6T Parameter Native Multimodal Model for Long-Horizon Agents
item.description:
Meituan's LongCat team has released LongCat-2.5, a native multimodal large model with 1.6 trillion total parameters. By leveraging large-scale long-horizon reinforcement learning and multi-level discrete visual tokens, the model significantly enhances end-to-end engineering capabilities in complex codebase development, Visual Coding, and long-horizon agent tasks. Online access and APIs are currently available, with open-source weights coming soon.

原文标题：美团发布 LongCat-2.5：1.6T 参数原生多模态模型，强化长程智能体能力

Why it matters：超大参数量结合原生多模态与长程 RL 训练，直击当前 AI Agent 落地的核心痛点（长上下文与复杂任务规划），具备极高的行业关注度。

item.title: Samsung Plans Dec Launch of AI Glasses in US and Korea with Gemini Integration
item.description:
Samsung plans to launch its first AI smart glasses, tentatively named 'Intelligent Eyewear', in South Korea and the US by mid-December. Built on Android XR with integrated Gemini AI and Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1, the device focuses on voice interaction, real-time translation, and environmental awareness without a display, aiming to compete with Meta.

item.title: Aramco Acquires 49% Stake in AI Firm HUMAIN for $2.3B
item.description:
Saudi Aramco has acquired a 49% stake in AI startup HUMAIN, with PIF retaining the remaining 51%. The deal involves transferring key AI assets and injecting approximately 9.9 billion Saudi riyals (about $2.3 billion). Both shareholders will contribute resources to expand HUMAIN's operations and accelerate the integration of advanced AI capabilities into industrial applications.

item.title: Delaware Proposes Law Allowing AI Agents to Form and Operate Companies
item.description:
Delaware plans to relax business regulations to allow companies operated by AI agents (AICs) to register. The draft includes a 30-month regulatory sandbox to provide legal certainty for autonomous entities, though it raises congressional concerns about liability evasion.

item.description:
Recent data reveals a peak in US public opposition to data centers, with 73% of city council meetings showing zero supporters. Water consumption is the primary concern, and skepticism towards Big Tech's promised community benefits is widespread. Notably, most comments focus on infrastructure impacts rather than AI itself.

item.title: Python 3.15 依赖报错时删除 uv.lock 文件可快速修复
item.description:
在迁移至 Python 3.15 过程中，若因依赖包缺乏对应预编译轮子导致构建失败，删除本地生成的 uv.lock 文件并重新运行命令通常能解决版本锁定冲突。该技巧特别适用于未提交锁文件的库项目开发场景。

Why it matters：针对特定 Python 版本迁移期的常见工具链故障提供了简单有效的即时解决方案。
